prevalidationSummary.honestyPolicy: 로컬 사전 검증 6건은 합성 코퍼스·로컬 엔진·장애 주입·정적/정책 감사의 실측 증거이며, 라이선스 실파일·실제 OAuth 테넌트·실기기 하드웨어·외부 독립 감사·프로 작가 최종 서명을 대체하지 않는다. replacementClaimAllowed=false 경계를 그대로 유지한다.

localPrevalidations.title: PSD advanced object preservation
localPrevalidations.summaryKo: 합성 다중레이어 PSD(53062B) 왕복 검증 완료: 래스터 7/7 픽셀 일치, 블렌드모드 7/7, 마스크 3/3, 조정 레이어 8/8 대칭 왕복, 8K(7680×4320) 헤더 사전 검사 통과.
localPrevalidations.externalBoundaryNote: Golden PSD corpus round-trip must be signed by the compatibility lab.

localPrevalidations.title: PSB and large document streaming
localPrevalidations.summaryKo: PSB v2 바이너리(140618B, 2레이어) 왕복 및 8K/초과치수·16비트·CMYK fail-closed 가드(차단 코드 4종)와 메모리 예산 회계 검증 완료.
localPrevalidations.externalBoundaryNote: Large PSB corpus and memory-soak evidence is required.

localPrevalidations.title: Truthful CLIP migration lane
localPrevalidations.summaryKo: CSP .clip(472268B, 4계층 레이어·마스크 픽셀 100% 일치) 및 .sut(12288B, 브러시 IR 1건·내장 PNG 1건) 파서 실측 완료.
localPrevalidations.externalBoundaryNote: CLIP support remains migration-grade until licensed corpus verification is complete.

localPrevalidations.title: File round-trip golden corpus lab
localPrevalidations.summaryKo: 합성 골든 코퍼스 왕복 완료: SVG(2029자 → SceneIR 5노드), CMYK 인쇄 PDF(8815B, 도련/재단마크/중철), 벡터 PDF 1.7(794B), 위험 확장자(.exe) 차단 확인.
localPrevalidations.externalBoundaryNote: Licensed real-world PSD, PSB and CLIP golden corpora are required.

localPrevalidations.title: Collaboration fault-injection lab
localPrevalidations.summaryKo: 3노드 Yjs CRDT 파티션 재연결 0-충돌 수렴(SHA-256 일치), V12 장애주입(GPU 100회·워커 1000회·저널복구 64회·유실 0건), SQLite 손상 LKG 복구 및 3-Way 병합 실측 완료.
localPrevalidations.externalBoundaryNote: Multi-user WAN and forced process-loss runs are required.

localPrevalidations.title: Accessibility and security audit
localPrevalidations.summaryKo: 접근성 WCAG 감사(준수 pass·위반 6건 차단), 보안 자문 예외 0건·핀 6종·CodeQL 회귀 0건, Rights BOM 락파일 정상 통과 및 위반 4건 차단 검증 완료.
localPrevalidations.externalBoundaryNote: Independent accessibility and security audits are required.

externalOnlyBoundaries.title: Desktop synchronization agent
externalOnlyBoundaries.externalBoundaryNote: Signed desktop builds and OS watcher soak evidence are required.

externalOnlyBoundaries.title: Local folder binding
externalOnlyBoundaries.externalBoundaryNote: Browser permission and desktop filesystem matrices require real-device validation.

externalOnlyBoundaries.title: Google Drive adapter
externalOnlyBoundaries.externalBoundaryNote: A real Google OAuth tenant and upload/download round trip are required.

externalOnlyBoundaries.title: Dropbox adapter
externalOnlyBoundaries.externalBoundaryNote: A real Dropbox OAuth tenant and upload/download round trip are required.

externalOnlyBoundaries.title: Input, render and long-document performance lab
externalOnlyBoundaries.externalBoundaryNote: Representative pen devices and long-running hardware evidence are required.

externalOnlyBoundaries.title: Professional creator end-to-end validation
externalOnlyBoundaries.externalBoundaryNote: A professional creator must complete and sign off an end-to-end production episode.
